summary: Accounts and groups that no longer matter are left out of your assets by default.

fixes.title: Inactive identities are left out by default
fixes.text: Never-synced Active Directory accounts that are disabled and not privileged, and groups Entra ID no longer has, are no longer assets by default. A value you chose is kept; turn a setting off to record them again.

fixes.title: Left-out items retire, never count as fixed
fixes.text: Their existing assets retire with a reason naming the setting, and their findings close as asset retired, never as fixed. The Data health page counts what was left out.

fixes.title: Same install lines everywhere
fixes.text: The two install lines are now the same in the README, release notes, release page, documentation and the installer's help.
